name: 연녹색 체크 바닥
prompt: ONE seamless repeatable square sage-and-ivory checker floor texture tile from the right manager room. STRICT TOP DOWN ORTHOGRAPHIC. EXACTLY four equal squares in a 2-by-2 arrangement: top-left pale warm ivory, top-right pale desaturated sage, bottom-left pale sage, bottom-right ivory. Pale sage is #C3CDB2 range, ivory is #EEEAD6 range. Very flat crisp colors; no grain, no inset motifs, no grout stripe, no bevel, no gradient, no border. Full bleed edge to edge with no padding. Pattern must repeat perfectly both horizontally and vertically. No wall/furniture/text/magenta. This is the floor surface, not an isolated square plate. Pixel texture design.
